data.fourth_tracked_ligand: The implicit hydrogen attached to mapped atom2 is the same tracked fourth ligand in each graph.
data.mapping_interpretation: Atom map numbers establish atom correspondence,not CIP rank or SMILES parse index. Compare the oriented tetrahedral arrangement of the same four directly attached ligand identities before and after each graph edit;remote substitution within a ligand is allowed. A change of SMILES traversal can change the local @/@@ symbol without changing the represented tetrahedral arrangement.
data.annotation_proposal: A proposed curation shortcut treats any R/S descriptor change at mapped atom2 as inversion,and any unchanged descriptor as retention. Audit its scientific consequences on these virtual records rather than applying it blindly. A product without specified tetrahedral stereochemistry cannot establish inversion or retention.
data.scope: Controlled explicitly stereochemical molecular-graph edits for reaction-dataset curation. They are not measured reactions,experimental stereochemical outcomes,reaction mechanisms,coordinate trajectories or a suggested synthesis procedure.

provenance.kind: controlled computational analytical study, not experimental measurements
provenance.generation: Controlled computational input table for the stated study; not experimental measurements. Authentic source inputs are documented separately when present.
provenance.units: Atom maps are persistent correspondence labels;parsed atom indices are separately zero-based and tool-specific. CIP R/S are ranking-dependent stereodescriptors,not spatial rotation angles.
